page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical Intel Xeon 8369HB cores operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, the instance provides 96 vCPUs without hyperthreading. The memory configuration consists of 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring reliance on network-attached storage options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type. The lack of local storage and hardware acceleration represents a tradeoff for workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space or parallelized graphics processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation combined with a high memory-to-core ratio offers high resource density for memory-intensive applications. This configuration is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing pipelines that do not require GPU acceleration.
